decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the core offer and has its own page, so it costs little to keep and is still too new for its value to be judged, and space sales cycles are long.
The modular navigation camera fits the firm's move toward flexible sensors for small satellites, so it is a cheap option with real upside that should stay open while missions are still being booked.
Space situational awareness is a growing but uncertain market, and the product reaches somewhat beyond the core, yet one year is far too short to resolve its value, so the option stays open.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, which suggests an early development stage, but it is close to the firm's docking and navigation know-how and its uncertainty is still high, so keeping it at low cost beats abandoning it now.
